## Summary
Describe the change and the bug or requirement it addresses.

## Root cause
Explain why the issue happened. If not yet confirmed, say so explicitly.

## Fix
Describe the smallest safe fix and why it addresses the root cause.

## Verification
- [ ] Relevant automated tests added or updated
- [ ] Tests run locally or in GitHub Actions; link results where possible
- [ ] Android / backend behavior checked where relevant
- [ ] No secrets or private data added
- [ ] Security findings reviewed, not suppressed
- [ ] Dependency changes reviewed for compatibility and advisories
- [ ] User-facing errors are clear and do not expose secrets or internal details

## Risk and rollback
Describe possible side effects and how to revert safely.
